scenes.title: Light the surface and take pictures

vo.text: Underneath, an LED lights the surface.
vo.speak: Underneath, an LED lights the surface.

vo.text: A tiny camera takes rapid pictures of the texture.
vo.speak: A tiny camera takes rapid pictures of the texture.

vo.text: The dots have not changed. Their positions have shifted.
vo.speak: The dots have not changed. Their positions have shifted.

vo.text: The processor compares the images and measures that shift.
vo.speak: The processor compares the images and measures that shift.

vo.text: If the texture moves left in the images, the mouse must have moved right.
vo.speak: If the texture moves left in the images, the mouse must have moved right.

vo.text: That measured movement becomes the cursor's motion.
vo.speak: That measured movement becomes the cursor's motion.

vo.text: On a plain, glossy surface, there may be too little texture to compare.
vo.speak: On a plain, glossy surface, there may be too little texture to compare.

vo.text: That is why tracking can fail.
vo.speak: That is why tracking can fail.

vo.text: An optical mouse does not feel direction. It measures changing pictures.
vo.speak: An optical mouse does not feel direction. It measures changing pictures.
